source_jar: 浩天奇缘-神装现世_触摸屏通用版(360x640)_local_update.jar
resource_loading: 2102 creates a cr entity; cr.a(name,id,class,...) loads ck.b(74 + class). ck reads the indexed /5 record through aq.c(), which consumes the leading record byte before ao parses the sprite.
weapon_selection: The 2102 packed entity fields set the current weapon mode; 1264 updates slot 8 as well. In the slot-8 value, bits 4..7 select one of three weapon animation modes, bits 8..11 are passed to a separate character animation state, and bits 0..3 are stored in cr.n. No use of cr.n to select a /6 mapping was found in the character render path. /6 component maps exist, but their selection for player characters is not established here. cr.D() has further G/X-dependent animation branches; the listed normal/alternate groups are base tables rather than a runtime trace for every actor state.
scope: Every animation group present in the shared decoded index is listed for each of the three class sprites; available groups are within 0..101 and include male/shared and female-labeled variants. Image and raw resource paths reference existing shared exports; no duplicate frames or binaries are copied here. Appearance mappings are described but not baked into the shared animation PNGs; equipment item IDs to display values and specific armor semantics remain unresolved.

variants.1: animation groups 51..101 (female labels in the existing visual index)

visual_variant_offset.protocol_bit_semantics: The decompiled entity bit is retained as ai; associating its 0/1 values with gender is supported by group labels but not independently confirmed by a captured packet.
